title: Topstitches issues never fixed in CLO3D
content:
So this post is about a couple issues with topstitches and bugs that I've always faced in CLO3D despite the new versions that came out.   
  
1) Topstitch tool:   
the topstitch tool seem to work fine except for one thing, the 3D toggle that activates the normal map for the topstitches is still buggy in the 3D viewport, it doesn't matter if I'm running the simulation at higher quality or not, the normal map for the **3D effect** sometimes is visible, sometimes disappears and is not visible anymore. Also the intensity slider even if you put it at 100 is not enough.   
  
2) Livesync issues:   
When using livesync 2.0 with Unreal Engine 5.6+ the imported garment gets imported with **white solid lines** when toggling "**include seampuckering normalmap** " in livesync and sometimes the UV are totally **misaligned**.   
The **white lines** correspond to the exact seam of the garment where the topstitch is _applied_. Its like a texture problem for the topstiches.  
If you**don't** toggle the "**include seampuckering normalmap** " the garment gets imported with the correct topstitches textures but no normalmap so they are very flat and badlooking, also if you have a **double needle topstitching** the second line won't be visible in UE5.6.   
If you instead just toggle "**Unified UV coordinates** " you just get horrible warped and very deep topstitching with no textures, just warped normalmaps.  
  
**__Right now is a mess to get both normalmap and good toptstitches textures in UE5.__**  
  
Also I want to point out that the imported garments in UE5 90% of the times have different material properties (but i guess that's how it works between different 3D softwares) but still, it would be nice to have a better materials compatibility without always ending up fixing the whole textures in UE5.

We always recommend posting from the account that is attached to your active CLO Subscription,For further assistance please let us know what your active CLO ID is or repost from the account with an active license. This will help us further assist youThank you

title: Happy Christmas! Everyone!
content:
I don't use AI very well, but this time, I made an AI model to wear my clothes and used it for the first time for a Christmas look.

For this visual, I used CLO-modeled clothes, but we used AI-made models, AI-made backgrounds. 

The AI used nanobanana.![ec7f76bb0ad14fea9563083ac1e6e92b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/ec7f76bb0ad14fea9563083ac1e6e92bGenerated%20Image%20December%2024%2C%202025%20-%205_36AM.jpeg)

I chose it because the time given was not long, but I think it was a good way to complete it in time for Christmas Eve.

![c057723a6a8c4904a535e2f6a33ddfda](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/c057723a6a8c4904a535e2f6a33ddfdaGenerated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%208_11AM.jpg)

I think it's a way of working that I'll often use when I don't have long time to invest in render in the future.

![4d25f66a8cc64cceae3026092fa58070](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/4d25f66a8cc64cceae3026092fa58070Generated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%2011_48PM.jpeg)

I've heard Nanobanana's reputation well, but I think it's so good as a way to use it instead of a render.

  
Above all, I think it's very satisfactory that you don't change the details of the clothes arbitrarily.

I was very surprised to see that the characteristics of the velvet fabric, Fur fabric used in CLO reflect very well.

Rendered it in A pose so that the clothes wouldn't be covered up, and just ordered it to "wear it" as a prompt, they understood so well.

![fda7e4f446df4485b67d31c76f56da8b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/fda7e4f446df4485b67d31c76f56da8bChristmas%20Look.png)

There are many people who already use it, but I recommend you to use it when you have a lot of worries about directing factors such as poses and backgrounds.  
  
Then have a happy Christmas!

![b8c2482eac414b8b8f989adad4b2b306](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/b8c2482eac414b8b8f989adad4b2b306Generated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%208_07AM.jpeg)

title: Error - Failed To Live Update
content:
While I try to update the app I get this error and the update starts over.

I tried It several times.

How can I fix It?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I have similar issue, every single update fails. Then I have to uninstall and reinstall. Raised case once, and they asked to uninstall and reinstall too. I know it works, sometimes doesn't too. But it's frustrating to uninstall and reinstall every month when CLO is having updates every month. We appreciate the new tools. But it's wasting too much of the users time. :(
Reply 1: Hi, there is no need to uninstall CLO in case you aren't looking to do the complete uninstall to correct an issue. I never use the Live Update button, always get the installer from the download page, and install the new version on top without uninstalling. It simply overwrites the current installation unless you specifically rename it during the installation process.

Comment 2: Update here as well. I tried to clean install now It worked.

Comment 3: Thank you @CLO Designer - YouTube LiveSharing my update on the issue- I have uninstall the clo by following all the description mentioned in the https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f and then installed the latest version, and it worked.

Comment 4: I finally decided to try to use a 5g hotspot to download and it went. It's incredibly frustrating if the speed of the internet is stopping live updates.

Comment 5: I have the same problem. It doesn't matter which computer I use, the last few updates failed halway through. I shouldn't have to reinstall every time there is an update. Please advise the update team that this is a HUGE problem.

Comment 6: I removed the app and reinstalled. The problem remains.???

Comment 7: If you have failed to live update multiple times the fastest solution is often to uninstall CLO. Then download CLO again from our website1) Save your work files, including CLO project files, in a safe place, Do not save your own project files neither in the public asset folder nor the installation folder. (It is necessary in order to prevent the loss of your project files during the re-installation steps.) 2) Please refer to the web document below to completely delete CLO and the files that make up CLO from your computer. https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f 3) Download the latest installer from the CLO website and install it with administrator privileges. You can download the latest Installer here: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f
